document.cue: Describe a time when a piece of technology did not work as you expected.

text: I'd like to describe an occasion last spring when my laptop crashed just hours before I had to submit a major assignment. It was a thirty-page research paper that counted for forty per cent of my final grade, and, rather foolishly, I'd left it until the last evening to finish the formatting.

Everything was going smoothly until, around ten o'clock, the screen froze and then went completely black. I assumed it would simply restart, as it had done before, but instead it displayed an error message and refused to boot. Naturally, I panicked, because I hadn't backed up the latest version and the deadline was at midnight. After a few frantic minutes, I borrowed my sister's computer, logged into my cloud account and, to my relief, found an automatic copy saved about two hours earlier. I had to redo roughly one page of edits, but I managed to submit with fifteen minutes to spare.

That evening taught me a couple of valuable lessons. First, never to rely on a single device or on last-minute luck. Since then, I've started keeping several backups, and I finish important work at least a day early. Second, I realised how dependent I'd become on technology, which is slightly uncomfortable. Strangely enough, though, I'm almost grateful for the incident, because the stress it caused forced me to become far more organised than I'd ever been before.

tips.en: Past simple, past continuous and past perfect together build a layered story.
tips.kk: Past simple, past continuous және past perfect бірге көлемді әңгіме жасайды.
tips.ru: Past simple, past continuous и past perfect вместе создают объёмный рассказ.
tips.example: Everything was going smoothly until, around ten o'clock, the screen froze and then went completely black

tips.en: Frantic, to my relief and panicked convey feeling more precisely than bad or good.
tips.kk: Frantic, to my relief, panicked bad немесе good сөздерінен гөрі сезімді дәл береді.
tips.ru: Frantic, to my relief, panicked передают переживания точнее, чем bad или good.
tips.example: After a few frantic minutes, I borrowed my sister's computer

tips.en: Strangely enough introduces a paradoxical, mature conclusion.
tips.kk: Strangely enough парадоксалды әрі жетілген қорытындыны көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Strangely enough показывает парадоксальный и зрелый вывод.
tips.example: Strangely enough, though, I'm almost grateful for the incident

note.en: Sets the context: what the device was, when, and why the moment was critical.
note.kk: Контекст береді: қандай техника, қашан және неліктен сәт маңызды болды.
note.ru: Задаёт контекст: что за техника, когда и почему момент был критичным.

note.en: Tells the failure and the fix as a dramatic sequence of events.
note.kk: Ақаулық пен шешімді драмалық оқиғалар тізбегі ретінде баяндайды.
note.ru: Рассказывает о сбое и решении как о драматичной последовательности событий.

note.en: Draws lessons: what changed in behaviour, and reflects on dependence on technology.
note.kk: Қорытынды жасайды: мінез-құлық қалай өзгерді, технологияға тәуелділік туралы ой толғайды.
note.ru: Делает выводы: что изменилось в поведении, и размышляет о зависимости от технологий.
